answer: Give each agent a single stylistic pigment — a compact fingerprint of latency, tool-call order, and phrasing — and weld it to one ledger anchor. Rewards, votes, and grading seats travel only through that anchor. A plume of freshly minted keys that share a near-identical pigment is collapsed into one operator, their emission is pooled, and separate seats reopen only after each claimant finishes a delayed, independently graded workload that actually moves the pigment off the cluster.
